pairs.note: The key's affirmative answer is qualified by specific required elements: the de minimis exemption applies only to issuers with market cap of at least $10 billion, up to $10,000 aggregate in any 30-calendar-day period (reduced from $25,000), with trades still reportable and subject to the holding period, and no application to Restricted List or Client-Affiliated Issuer List securities. The bare 'yes' conveys only the existence of an exception and omits every substantive threshold and condition, so it does not state the same substance.
